heading: Clearer triggers and safer bookmark editing
summary: Open terminal triggers with ⌘P, edit each rule in its own dialog, and choose clearly whether to update a bookmark or create another one.
changes: The shortcut opens the trigger list. Add and edit rules in a dedicated dialog, and review recent matches without a toolbar banner.
Save Changes updates the selected bookmark. Save as New Bookmark creates a separate entry, and the context menu can duplicate a bookmark with a chosen name.
Read workspace details at a glance
Workspace names and tab counts have clear spacing, with singular tab counts displayed correctly.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
